questions.stem: A 30-year-old female patient with treatment-resistant schizophrenia has started on clozapine. What is the appropriate duration and frequency of blood test monitoring for this patient taking clozapine?

options.label: A
options.text: Weekly for 6 months, bi-weekly for 6 months, then monthly.

options.label: B
options.text: Monthly for 6 months, then every 3 months.

options.label: C
options.text: Weekly for 3 months, bi-weekly for 3 months, then monthly.

options.label: D
options.text: Monthly for 1 year, then every 6 months.
